Dress code

✧

Formal attire

Elegant, classy and celebration ready.

Pastel tones welcome

Clubhouse attire requirements

Proper attire must be worn in the Clubhouse. The following are not allowed:

  • Singlets
  • Collarless T-shirts (for men)
  • Tank tops
  • Jogging shorts
  • Slippers

The Club reserves the right to turn down anyone who is not properly dressed according to its requirements.

A few things to note

Wedding guidelines

♧

Dine with us

All food must be enjoyed within the Club. Packing or taking food away is strictly prohibited for hygiene and food safety reasons, including the risk of food poisoning after food leaves the premises.

✧

Let the photographer capture it

Please give our photographer space to capture the special moments and keep their view clear. Relax and enjoy the celebration—we’ll share the photographs with you afterwards.

♡

Care for our venue

Please treat the Club’s property, furnishings and decorations with care. Help us leave everything just as we found it.

✧

A little colour, please

Please avoid white or black outfits. We’d love to see you in other colours, with soft pastel tones especially welcome.

Here are some helpful answers

A little more to know

What time should I be there?

VIP guests

Please arrive by 5:00 PM for the tea ceremony.

All other guests

Please arrive by 7:00 PM for the wedding dinner.

Is there parking at the venue?
  • Please park at the Sentosa Pavilion / SDC car park.
  • Parking lots are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
  • Parking is permitted from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM only. No overnight parking is allowed.
  • Parking vouchers will be included.
How do I get there from Sentosa?

From within Sentosa: Take the Sentosa Express to Beach Station if you’re near a monorail station, or make your way directly to Beach Station Transfer Hub. Board the free Sentosa Bus B and alight at the Sentosa Golf Club stop, then follow the signs to the clubhouse.

Coming from VivoCity: Take the Sentosa Express monorail from VivoCity to Beach Station, then transfer to Bus B as above. Monorail coupons will be provided.

By taxi or Grab: Set your destination to Sentosa Golf Club, 27 Bukit Manis Road, Singapore 099892.

Please allow time for the bus connection and check the latest route before travelling. Sentosa transport guide ↗

Can I bring a plus one?

Please check with Claribelle or Ronald before adding a guest.
